quest.title: Encirclement of Bullets and Silk
quest.description: The criminal puppetmaster lurking in the shadows has finally taken the bait. Yelan from Liyue's Ministry of Civil Affairs and Chevreuse from Fontaine's Maison Gardiennage have embarked on a rare joint operation. However, apprehending the perpetrator isn't the only issue they have to ponder...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

chapter.num: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part II
chapter.title: Encirclement of Bullets and Silk

talks.objective: Wait until 07:00 – 10:00 two days from now
Go to the event venue to find out more from Yelan and the rest

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Wow! Can this launch blaster thing really shoot stuff from that far away?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Haha, it does launch and blast things, but it's actually called a "ballista." And, yes, it can.

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: But how does it stay on target?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It uses a remote guidance system. But I'll let you in on a little secret... The upgraded version doesn't even need that.

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Can I give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hahaha, not a chance, kid. Can't have you hurting yourself. Believe me, this thing is even more powerful than it looks. Ask me again once you're older.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Beidou! Whatcha up to?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two! I was just introducing our product to these discerning young customers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon thought you were here for some, y'know... "fishing"? Wait, are these three...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: What? No, of course not. The kids were just curious, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry. Are these three preventing you from doing business? Lemme get them out of your hair. C'mon, time to go.

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Aw, do we have to?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Don't sweat it. They were just curious. I'm happy to tell them more about it.

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: No, no. We've taken up enough of your time already. Neb, don't bother people when they're trying to work, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It was no bother, I swear. In fact, once the expo is over, come find me on my ship, and I'll let you see the ballista in action. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: How much would it cost?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Not a single Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Really? It's a promise then, miss!

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Your vessel... It's a battleship, isn't it? Are you sure you should be bringing children on board?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Why not? Whenever we're docked back in Liyue to pick up supplies, I always let the kids around the harbor come aboard to play, and boy, do they love it.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If a kid from Liyue can do it, why not a kid from Sumeru? A battleship may as well be a giant playground to them...

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Is that so... I've heard that people in Liyue also turn gunpowder into explosive firecrackers and give them to children as toys.

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Perhaps only the kids back in your home country are lucky enough to look at a giant battleship... and see a playground.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If you're worried about safety, I can—

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: No, I suppose I'm just... envious, that's all. I'll be sure to bring them over if we get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Seems like he really cares about those kids, huh... Anyway, what did you want to talk about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, just wanted to ask how it's going with the top-secret... uhh, fishing... Did you reel in the catch of the day yet?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: They're circling the hook just fine... Just waiting for a bite.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Shh...

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: That just proves my point. Something like this would only see more use in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ah, except you'd never find something like this for sale there. Better jump on the chance now before it's too late!

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: ...Excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's coming this way...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Steady now.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Hmph, that's mighty expensive...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: No one's forcing you to buy it. If you're not interested, you're free to move along.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: What? Come on, there's no rule saying we can't haggle.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The Voynich Guild gets a cut of whatever I sell. Obviously, that's factored into the price. Don't like it, take it up with them.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Listen, I can tell this is something special. If you're willing to go a bit lower, I'm prepared to cut a huge deal.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I know it's something special, so I plan on getting paid what it's worth.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps there's a way we can both get what we want, then.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: What are you implying?

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Nod-Krai's a big place. Surely, this expo isn't the only place we can cut a deal?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: What would you say to working this out someplace else? Somewhere the Guild can't get a cut?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hmph, that means no Guild protection either. What will I do if you run off without paying?

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Considering the giant sword you've got handy, if anyone's getting robbed, it'd be me, don't you think? Point is, we're both going out on a limb here. But, the reward's worth the risk.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: ...Fine. Name a place. As a registered participant, though, I'm too close to the Guild. If we don't want them catching on, I'll need to send a proxy.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Mmm, smart thinking. Let's meet here, then.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Good, he took the bait. Let's go elsewhere to discuss our next move.

talks.objective: Discuss what to do next with everyone

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou's hook was what got 'em in the end, huh... Aw, I didn't get a chance to show off how convincing I can be!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: This isn't Tabletop Troupe, Navia. In real life, persuasion takes a lot more than a dice roll.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I brought a product tailor-made for Fontaine because I thought the group's activities were limited to that area.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Turns out, we're dealing with an international crime ring. So, I suppose it makes sense that Captain Beidou's bait was more enticing. It's a good thing we teamed up.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We wouldn't have gotten far without your intel, either. Gotta ask, though... How did you know these guys would be so quick to abandon the expo?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I read their file. Nothing's off the table for them when profit's on the line.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: When it comes down to it, they'd see the "protection" the expo provides as just more red tape... Something to work around rather than with — just like the law.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we meet up with this guy, catch him, and problem solved, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, the person we're meeting is just an underling sent to scout the situation — we're after the leader of the whole ring.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: And, after observing the situation over the past two days, it's clear they have undercover agents waiting in the wings.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If something happens to our point of contact, those agents will scatter to spread word of what happened, and whoever is behind this whole thing will know we're onto them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, in that case...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We have to get the jump on them all at once, and use them to get intel on our real target before he has a chance to react.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Forgive me for pointing out the obvious, though... We have nowhere near enough personnel for that. If even one of the agents escapes, it's over.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Lemme guess — you'd rather follow this deal through to the end to lure out the real culprit? Nice idea in theory.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: The problem is, in my experience, that person would never show their face for something like this.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I can work around that. But only as long as the deal goes ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: So, you're planning to trail the person picking up the goods? I suppose that could lead us to the big fish, but... that would mean we have to actually hand over the weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Aren't you worried about putting something that dangerous in the hands of criminals?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We can control how dangerous it is. But if we followed your plan... Could we really guarantee that not a single agent would get away?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...You're telling me you really have a way to mitigate the threat of that weapon?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...You're telling me that you really have the wherewithal to carry out a large-scale search and seizure operation in Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are they... having a fight?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: They're both experts in this sort of thing. A lot of back and forth is to be expected.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I think they're getting along great.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: A successful collaboration requires trust... and a willingness to make concessions.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So, how about this? I'll meet up with the underling as planned and stall him as long as possible. While I'm keeping him busy, you round up the rest of the agents. Sound like a plan?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Yes, I appreciate the trust, and I promise you... not a single one will get away.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: See? Like two peas in a pod!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you should come with me to meet the buyer. After all, we promised Nefer you would be involved in all our operations.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s kind of a famous face around these parts, though...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Then, you can serve as backup. Remain hidden, and on the off chance he tries anything, it'll be two against one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, let's do this thing!

choices.text: He doesn't stand a chance against both of us.

talks.objective: Go to The Flagship with Yelan

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there he is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shh.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: You really can't go lower?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Best I can do is shave off the amount the Guild was going to take.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: You're a tough nut to crack... How do you plan to deliver the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Depends on what you need. You don't look like you're from around these parts, so I'm guessing you need sea transport?

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Yes, but there are a lot of eyes on the port. It would be better to dismantle the product and transport the components in crates.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm... That might be tricky. If you're worried about getting caught, then let's bypass the port entirely. We can launch from a secluded shoreline and use our own boat for transport.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I'd still prefer to have it dismantled and stored in regular crates.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Ah... I'm guessing that port of arrival is where you resell the goods? You want it hidden in unassuming cargo crates... because you operate right out in the open.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Most of the weapons have come in through Yilong Wharf or Lumidouce Harbor... so that seems to check out.

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Haha... What are you trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Nothing. Just connecting some dots. I think... we're done here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's our cue!

dialogues.speaker: Spy
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, take that!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Outta the way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's one of the undercover agents! He's making a break for it!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The Captain of the Special Patrol will take it from here.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: One just popped up... Looks like the one on the surface has been subdued.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: There are children around... I have to avoid bloodshed.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Hmph, trying to escape? Allow me to show you the way...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Nope, not this way.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: What's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Faster than I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Had enough? Then, turn around.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Ugh...!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Hah...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Out of steam yet? 'Cause I can do this all day.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Ah, look what we have here... Hmph, I think I'll borrow this signboard for a sec.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Argh! My leg...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...Is still attached. And if you want to keep it that way, I suggest you stay right where you are.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: A Special Patrol uniform... Heh, you think bringing me in is enough? Do you even know how many of us there are? If even one gets a—

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Five at the port, ten on the outskirts of Nasha Town, three near the plaza... Factoring in you and the buyer, that makes twenty.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Save the best for last, right?

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: How did you...

dialogues.speaker: Spina di Rosula Branch Member
dialogues.text: Don't even think about it!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Well done, everyone. We appreciate the assist. The boss sends her thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Spina di Rosula Branch Member
dialogues.text: It was an honor! Without the Spina's help back in the day, we never would have been able to make it in Nod-Krai. It was about time we returned the favor!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Pfft...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: What? I needed to make you seem intimidating to get these local gangs on our side. We've been over this.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yeah, I know. But, hearing you call me "boss" will never not be hilarious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Navia is something else...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, that explains your confidence. I had no idea the Spina di Rosula could mobilize these kinds of numbers outside of Fontaine. This Navia has quite a few tricks up her sleeve...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: No trade expo rules were broken, either. Even if Nefer saw it all unfold herself, we still wouldn't need to explain a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Except for the Guild's broken signboard, I would imagine...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...It was an unavoidable sacrifice.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: At any rate, I suppose the next step is to get these birds to sing? Should be an easy job. The Maison Gardiennage has a reputation for... highly effective interrogation tactics.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: And if that doesn't work, I've heard that spies from Liyue have their ways of making people talk as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess that means the operation was a success, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: So far. Once we get someone to reveal who the mastermind behind all this is, that's when the real work begins.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'm sure that person is in hiding somewhere far removed from the expo. But as far as our deal with the Curatorium goes, I think that's a wrap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shouldn't we update Nefer, then?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: First, we need to figure out what we can learn from these agents. We'll be in touch once we have the information, then we can head to the Curatorium together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds good.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With Navia's help, Yelan and Chevreuse escort the suspects away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that went a lot smoother than expected! Not a single one got away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The real story behind everything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're thinking about Nefer's final request, huh... Let's see, we have two expert detectives from separate nations teaming up to uncover an international crime ring... That's not a bad story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you feel like it's missing something, maybe Yelan and Chevreuse will uncover something more interesting during their interrogation.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: #Excuse me, are you {NICKNAME}? Jahoda needs you back at the expo venue as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't know the details. All she said was that it's urgent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's get a move on!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Either I throw the Guild under the bus or I get on the bad side of a terrifying merc captain... Ohh, could this get any worse?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Get it together, Jahoda! Focus on the hot dog you're gonna treat yourself to after today is over... One thing at a time. Alright, alright. You've got this! Hehe...)

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Let's try not to get too worked up, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Don't worry! We'll get to the bottom of this, I swear!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: #Ah, you're here! Please, you've gotta help me, {NICKNAME}! A theft at the expo is gonna ruin the Guild's reputation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A theft? How did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You're asking me! The Guild has people keeping watch over the storage area for this exact reason! And it just had to happen to one of the scariest people here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou? Wait, that means...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone stole the ballistas?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The Guild asked us to keep our goods stored on the designated shelves. I had a few prototypes that I was using for demonstration, which I had stored there.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But, when I came to check on things just now, I noticed that all of them had been stolen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And each ballista is super dangerous. If they fall into the wrong hands...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Well, all the prototypes have a fail-safe designed to prevent unauthorized use, so it could be worse. Still, we should get them back as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The Guild will make sure of that. If you could just keep this between us for now, we would be super appreciative, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Do we have to tell her?

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: Honesty is the best policy — that's what he taught us.

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: I know, it's just...

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Um, Miss Jahoda...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What are you three doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: There's something you want to tell me, isn't there...

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Well, Neb's been obsessed with the ballistas ever since we got here. That's why Uncle Ashvapati told us to come see your booth.

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: It seemed like he was interested in them too, because he even told us what parameters to ask about...

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Ever since this morning, we haven't been able to reach him. We wanted to ask Miss Jahoda for help, but then we heard about the ballistas being stolen...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: And?

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: I don't think Uncle Ashvapati would do something like that, but...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ashvapati works for the Guild. He has access to the storage warehouse, so he could get inside without the guards getting suspicious...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Wait, so now it's an inside job!? Oh geez, the Guild is never gonna recover from this!)

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: He made those "toys" the kids were selling, right? They don't look like much on the outside, but I bet they're hiding some serious tech...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If he's a tech guy... those fail-safes I mentioned might not have our backs after all.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sooo, this just went from bad to worse?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Uh oh...

choices.text: The question is, was he acting alone, or...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Could be... I mean, let's put it this way — there aren't a whole lot of people that could manage to stay off Yelan's radar.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Why don't you take these kids to the Curatorium and see what you can learn? I've got things covered here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hold up. We can't hold these kids responsible though, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, of course not. But... Ugh, how do we explain this?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: You wanna look out for these kids, don't you?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: ...I promised I would. Besides, they're innocent in all this.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Good, 'cause I'm looking out for them too. That's why I want to find their uncle as soon as possible. No matter what he did or didn't do, it's worse for them if he's missing.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Guess... we're on the same page then.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Take these kids to the Curatorium. I'll update Yelan and tell her to meet you there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will do!

choices.text: Is he connected to the crime ring?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You all exchange intel.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Well, this complicates things... Here I was hoping the trouble would start and end with you two.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: But no matter. This will all make for a very engaging "story."

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I wouldn't be so flippant. This time, it's one of yours causing trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I'm starting to wonder if all those agents we captured were just a distraction, so the real culprit could make their move.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It's all still up in the air right now. What can you three tell us about Ashvapati?

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: Uncle Ashvapati... isn't our real uncle, but he is our guardian. He adopted us when we were little.

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: He told us we all came from the same band of Eremites in the desert, but apparently, we're the only ones left...

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: We've been traveling from place to place with him for as long as I can remember. We got to Nod-Krai not too long ago...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Their eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: What about them?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'm just... reminded of something.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: About a decade ago, there was a band of Eremites who, seemingly out of nowhere, gained technological capabilities far surpassing those of other groups.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Leveraging that advantage, they built a number of highly advanced weapons and sold them to the highest bidder.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: The conflicts in the desert became even bloodier as a result. While the other groups were tearing each other to shreds, these newly minted arms traders stood by and reaped the spoils.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: But before long, their own weapons were turned against them, and as the flames of conflict engulfed the desert, the group met their end.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: None of the weapons survived, and so in the wake of that destruction, the status quo of the desert was restored.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: That's terrible...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: In the desert, it's kill or be killed. People will stop at nothing to gain the upper hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: If this happened in Fontaine or Liyue, I'm sure the perpetrators would have been prosecuted to the full extent of the law. But, in the desert, no one bats an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: From what they've told us, sounds like these kids are orphans from that particular band of Eremites.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Which means their guardian is likely one of the few survivors as well...

choices.text: So, the survivors of that band of Eremites...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Sounds like it.

response.speaker: Neb
response.text: No! Uncle Ashvapati would never do something like that!

response.speaker: Neb
response.text: No matter what happened back then, I know one thing for sure — Uncle Ashvapati hates weapons!

response.speaker: Neb
response.text: Sure, he's good at building things, but all he does is make toys for us to play with! He can't be the kind of person you're making him out to be, or... or...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I'm sorry. All we can do is act upon the facts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what's our next move?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: From our interrogations, we've learned that in two days, the person behind all this has a meeting planned to collect the goods. If all goes well, we can head to the pickup point and ambush them.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: But, if Ashvapati is part of this and the leader learns what happened, there's no chance he risks himself for his agents. So, that meeting might as well be moot.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Then, let's focus our efforts on Ashvapati for now. If we find him, he might just lead us to our culprit.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If he stole the prototypes, there's bound to be a trail. I'm confident I can track him down — I just need some time.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: What can I do to help?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I work best in the shadows. The more people involved, the harder it is to operate.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: As soon as I've got a location, though, he's all yours. You let me handle the search, and I'll let the Special Patrol handle the seizure.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Hm... That does sound like the most feasible plan. I'll be waiting for the good news.

response.speaker: Ati
response.text: Seizure...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't worry too much right now. The most important thing is that we find your uncle. The rest can wait.

response.speaker: Ati
response.text: Okay...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: #Looks like I'll need to enlist your services for a bit longer, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: As long as I get paid.
No worries. I also want to see this through.
Are back in the weapons business?
